title: Tensoring an algebra homomorphism with the identity gives an algebra homomorphism
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $A$, $C$, $N$ commutative $R$-algebras and $f:A\to C$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Give $A\otimes_RN$ and $C\otimes_RN$ their $R$-algebra structures, with multiplication $(a\otimes n)(a'\otimes n')=aa'\otimes nn'$ and unit $1\otimes1$. Then the $R$-linear map $f\otimes\mathrm{id}_N:A\otimes_RN\to C\otimes_RN$, $a\otimes n\mapsto f(a)\otimes n$, is a homomorphism of $R$-algebras, in particular a ring homomorphism.
